items.title: Capex fears trigger biggest Tech sell-off since 'Liberation Day'
items.summary: Capital expenditure (capex) concerns are weighing on technology stocks as investors scrutinize Big Tech's heavy spending on AI infrastructure. Robinhood (HOOD) chief investment officer Stephanie Guild and Miller Tabak managing director and equity strategist Matt Maley join Opening Bid Host Brian Sozzi to discuss why rising capex has become a key concern for the market.

items.title: Mastercard (MA) Expands Virtual Card Platform As Citi Prepares Global Launch
items.summary: Mastercard announced major upgrades to its virtual card number platform, adding new security controls, an embedded payments network, and unified API access. The company is targeting both enterprises and financial institutions looking to scale and secure virtual card programs. Citi will be the first issuer to launch these capabilities globally, signaling broad industry interest in the expanded platform.
